WARDOGS Controller Settings

A WARDOGS controller settings page structure for controller, keyboard, mouse, and keybind setup after verification.

Target keyword
wardogs controller settings
Priority
P1
Manual review
high

Quick Answer

Officially confirmed: WARDOGS has limited controller support in the current version according to the Steam developer FAQ.

Not officially confirmed: a complete Xbox / PlayStation button map, a full keybind table, controller-specific sensitivity values, deadzone settings, and current HOTAS support were not found in official public sources checked on August 28, 2026.

Use keyboard and mouse as the safest default expectation for launch-sensitive guidance, then verify any controller setup inside the current in-game controls menu before publishing exact bindings.

Needs Manual Review

Pre-release / Early Access sensitive: This is pre-release / Early Access sensitive content. Current details will be verified against the latest official build before publication.

Official Controller Support

  • Officially confirmed:The Steam developer FAQ says controller support is limited in the current version.
  • Officially confirmed:A Steam announcement says a development update covered gamepad support, but the checked public sources do not provide a complete controller layout.
  • Not officially confirmed:No official Xbox controller map, PlayStation controller map, or full Steam Input profile was found in the sources checked.

Input Options

  • Officially confirmed:Steam lists WARDOGS as a Windows PC game, and official material shows it as a PC / Steam Early Access launch.
  • Not officially confirmed:Official sources checked here do not publish a complete current-build list of aim sensitivity, controller sensitivity, deadzone, acceleration, or input smoothing options.
  • General guidance:Check the current in-game Settings or Controls menu before relying on any controller layout shared during beta or playtest periods.

Keyboard / Mouse vs Controller

  • General guidance:For a PC Early Access FPS with limited official controller support, keyboard and mouse should be treated as the most reliable default input path until controller behavior is verified in the current build.
  • Community-reported:Community discussions include mixed controller experiences, including players asking about gamepad support and reports that some bindings or interactions were not fully covered.

Keybinds and Rebinding

  • Not officially confirmed:A complete official WARDOGS keybind list has not been published in the sources checked.
  • Not officially confirmed:Official public sources checked here do not confirm exactly which keyboard, mouse, controller, vehicle, or helicopter bindings can be rebound.
  • General guidance:Document only the bindings shown by the live in-game menu after Early Access build verification.

Known Controller Issues

  • Community-reported:Steam community posts around beta access include controller and keybinding questions, but they are not official issue acknowledgements.
  • Not officially confirmed:No official controller-specific known-issues list was found in the public sources checked on August 28, 2026.

What Is Not Yet Confirmed

  • Not officially confirmed:Xbox controller layout, PlayStation controller layout, full rebinding coverage, aim assist, deadzone controls, controller sensitivity values, and HOTAS / flight-stick support for the current build are not confirmed in the checked official sources.
